fe2_valence_expansion.mechanism: charge compensation reduces Fe3+ to the larger Fe2+, expanding the spinel lattice
fe2_valence_expansion.relation: ionic radius r(Fe2+, 0.78 A) > r(Fe3+, 0.645 A) (Shannon 1976); Bragg: larger d -> lower 2theta
fe2_valence_expansion.source: Shannon, Acta Cryst. A32 (1976) 751; Cullity, Elements of X-ray Diffraction

ionic_radius_contraction.mechanism: smaller Ni2+ (0.69 A) and Al3+ (0.535 A) replace Co2+ (0.745 A) and Zn2+ (0.74 A), contracting the lattice (Vegard-type)
ionic_radius_contraction.relation: Vegard's law with Shannon radii; Bragg: smaller d -> higher 2theta

quantum_confinement.mechanism: quantum confinement in smaller crystallites widens the optical gap
quantum_confinement.relation: Brus: E_g(R) = E_g(bulk) + h^2/(8 R^2) (1/m_e + 1/m_h) - 1.8 e^2/(4 pi eps R)

defect_band_tailing.mechanism: dopant-induced oxygen vacancies and disorder add band-tail states that narrow the effective gap
defect_band_tailing.relation: Urbach tail: alpha = alpha0 exp((E - E0)/E_U), larger E_U with disorder

b_site_dilution.mechanism: non-magnetic Al3+ and lower-moment Ni2+ dilute the octahedral B sublattice, lowering M_B - M_A
b_site_dilution.relation: Neel two-sublattice model: M = M_B - M_A
b_site_dilution.source: Neel, Ann. Phys. 3 (1948) 137; Smit & Wijn, Ferrites (1959)

a_site_al_displacement.mechanism: Al3+ enters tetrahedral A sites and displaces Fe3+ to B sites, lowering M_A and raising the net moment
a_site_al_displacement.relation: Neel model with A-site dilution: M = M_B - M_A rises
